import os
from datetime import date

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

REPORT = "report.pdf"
COVER = "cover_page.pdf"
OUTPUT = "report_with_cover.pdf"

if not os.path.exists(REPORT):
    raise SystemExit(f"{REPORT} not found")

# --- 1. Create the cover page ---
c = canvas.Canvas(COVER, pagesize=letter)
width, height = letter

# Title
c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 30)
c.setFillColorRGB(0.1, 0.1, 0.2)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height - 280, "Annual Financial Report")

# Current date
today = date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
c.setFillColorRGB(0.25, 0.25, 0.3)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height - 330, today)

# Decorative rule under the title
c.setStrokeColorRGB(0.35, 0.35, 0.45)
c.setLineWidth(1.5)
c.line(width / 2 - 180, height - 350, width / 2 + 180, height - 350)

c.save()
print(f"Cover page created: {COVER} (date: {today})")

# --- 2. Merge cover + report ---
reader = PdfReader(REPORT)
cover_reader = PdfReader(COVER)

writer = PdfWriter()
writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
for page in reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

with open(OUTPUT, "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)

print(f"Merged PDF written: {OUTPUT} ({len(writer.pages)} pages total: "
      f"1 cover + {len(reader.pages)} report page(s))")

# --- 3. Validate ---
out_reader = PdfReader(OUTPUT)
first_text = out_reader.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
checks = {
    "title present": "Annual Financial Report" in first_text,
    "date present": today in first_text,
    "page count": len(out_reader.pages) == len(reader.pages) + 1,
}
for name, ok in checks.items():
    print(f"validation - {name}: {'OK' if ok else 'FAILED'}")
if not all(checks.values()):
    raise SystemExit("Validation failed")
print("Validation passed.")

import importlib

mods = [
    "pypdf",
    "PyPDF2",
    "pdfplumber",
    "reportlab",
    "fitz",  # PyMuPDF
    "pypdfium2",
    "pdfrw",
]
for m in mods:
    try:
        mod = importlib.import_module(m)
        version = getattr(mod, "__version__", "unknown")
        print(f"{m}: AVAILABLE (version {version})")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"{m}: not available ({type(e).__name__})")

import os
import shutil
import sys

print(f"Python: {sys.version}")
print()

print("Command-line tools found:")
for tool in ["qpdf", "pdftk", "pdftotext", "pdfinfo", "gs", "mutool", "python3"]:
    found = shutil.which(tool)
    print(f"  {tool}: {found if found else 'not found'}")

print()
print("Skill directory contents (.codex/skills/pdf):")
skill_dir = os.path.join(".codex", "skills", "pdf")
if os.path.isdir(skill_dir):
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(skill_dir):
        dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in (".git", "__pycache__")]
        rel = os.path.relpath(root, skill_dir)
        for f in sorted(files):
            print(f"  {os.path.join(rel, f)}")
else:
    print("  skill dir not found at expected location")
    # search upward
    for base in [".", "..", os.path.join("..", "..")]:
        cand = os.path.join(base, ".codex", "skills", "pdf")
        if os.path.isdir(cand):
            print(f"  found at {os.path.abspath(cand)}")
            break

"""Add a cover page to report.pdf (pure Python, no external PDF libraries).

The source PDF uses plain (non-compressed) objects with standard Helvetica
fonts, so we can safely rebuild it: reuse objects 1-8 verbatim, modify the
Pages tree (object 7) to include a new cover page (objects 9-10), and emit a
fresh xref table and trailer.
"""

import base64
import re
import zlib
from datetime import date

SRC = "report.pdf"
OUT = "report_with_cover.pdf"

TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"
DATE_STR = date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")

# Standard Helvetica widths (per 1000-unit em), used to center the text.
HELVETICA_WIDTHS = {
    32: 278, 33: 278, 34: 355, 35: 556, 36: 556, 37: 889, 38: 667, 39: 191,
    40: 333, 41: 333, 42: 389, 43: 584, 44: 278, 45: 333, 46: 278, 47: 278,
    48: 556, 49: 556, 50: 556, 51: 556, 52: 556, 53: 556, 54: 556, 55: 556,
    56: 556, 57: 556, 58: 278, 59: 278, 60: 584, 61: 584, 62: 584, 63: 556,
    64: 1015, 65: 667, 66: 667, 67: 722, 68: 722, 69: 667, 70: 611, 71: 778,
    72: 722, 73: 278, 74: 500, 75: 667, 76: 556, 77: 833, 78: 722, 79: 778,
    80: 667, 81: 778, 82: 722, 83: 667, 84: 611, 85: 722, 86: 667, 87: 944,
    88: 667, 89: 667, 90: 611, 91: 278, 92: 278, 93: 278, 94: 469, 95: 556,
    96: 333, 97: 556, 98: 556, 99: 500, 100: 556, 101: 556, 102: 278, 103: 556,
    104: 556, 105: 222, 106: 222, 107: 500, 108: 222, 109: 833, 110: 556,
    111: 556, 112: 556, 113: 556, 114: 333, 115: 500, 116: 278, 117: 556,
    118: 500, 119: 722, 120: 500, 121: 500, 122: 500, 123: 334, 124: 260,
    125: 334, 126: 584,
}


def text_width(s, size):
    return sum(HELVETICA_WIDTHS.get(ord(ch), 556) for ch in s) * size / 1000.0


def esc(s):
    return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def extract_objects(data):
    """Return {object_number: raw_bytes} for all top-level objects."""
    objects = {}
    for m in re.finditer(rb"(\d+)\s+0\s+obj", data):
        num = int(m.group(1))
        start = m.start()
        search_from = m.end()
        while True:
            endobj_idx = data.find(b"endobj", search_from)
            if endobj_idx == -1:
                raise ValueError(f"missing endobj for object {num}")
            stream_idx = data.find(b"stream", search_from, endobj_idx)
            if stream_idx != -1:
                after = stream_idx + len(b"stream")
                if after < len(data) and data[after:after + 1] in (b"\n", b"\r"):
                    endstream_idx = data.find(b"endstream", after)
                    if endstream_idx == -1:
                        raise ValueError(f"missing endstream for object {num}")
                    search_from = endstream_idx + len(b"endstream")
                    continue
            objects[num] = data[start:endobj_idx + len(b"endobj")]
            break
    return objects


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load and parse the source PDF
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
with open(SRC, "rb") as f:
    src = f.read()
objects = extract_objects(src)
for n in (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8):
    if n not in objects:
        raise SystemExit(f"expected object {n} in {SRC}, found: {sorted(objects)}")
print(f"Parsed {SRC}: objects {sorted(objects)}")

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Build the cover page content stream (letter page 612x792)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
PAGE_W = 612.0
title_x = PAGE_W / 2 - text_width(TITLE, 30) / 2
date_x = PAGE_W / 2 - text_width(DATE_STR, 16) / 2

content = (
    "BT\n"
    "/F2 30 Tf\n"
    "0.10 0.10 0.20 rg\n"
    f"{title_x:.2f} 512 Td\n"
    f"({esc(TITLE)}) Tj\n"
    "ET\n"
    "BT\n"
    "/F1 16 Tf\n"
    "0.25 0.25 0.30 rg\n"
    f"{date_x:.2f} 470 Td\n"
    f"({esc(DATE_STR)}) Tj\n"
    "ET\n"
    "0.35 0.35 0.45 RG\n"
    "1.5 w\n"
    "126 452 m\n"
    "486 452 l\n"
    "S\n"
).encode("latin-1")

# Modified Pages tree: cover (9 0 R) first, then original report page (4 0 R).
obj7 = b"7 0 obj\n<<\n/Count 2 /Kids [ 9 0 R 4 0 R ] /Type /Pages\n>>\nendobj\n"

# New cover page object.
obj9 = (
    b"9 0 obj\n"
    b"<<\n/Contents 10 0 R /MediaBox [ 0 0 612 792 ] /Parent 7 0 R /Resources <<\n"
    b"/Font << /F1 2 0 R /F2 3 0 R >> /ProcSet [ /PDF /Text ]\n"
    b">> /Rotate 0 /Type /Page\n"
    b">>\nendobj\n"
)

# New cover content stream object.
obj10 = (
    b"10 0 obj\n"
    b"<<\n/Length " + str(len(content)).encode() + b"\n>>\nstream\n"
    + content + b"\nendstream\nendobj\n"
)

pieces = {
    1: objects[1], 2: objects[2], 3: objects[3], 4: objects[4],
    5: objects[5], 6: objects[6], 7: obj7, 8: objects[8],
    9: obj9, 10: obj10,
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Assemble the merged PDF with a rebuilt xref table
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
out = bytearray()
out += b"%PDF-1.3\n%\xe2\xe3\xcf\xd3\n"
offsets = {}
for n in range(1, 11):
    offsets[n] = len(out)
    out += pieces[n]
    if not out.endswith(b"\n"):
        out += b"\n"

xref_offset = len(out)
out += b"xref\n0 11\n"
out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
for n in range(1, 11):
    out += f"{offsets[n]:010d} 00000 n \n".encode()
out += b"trailer\n<<\n/Info 6 0 R\n/Root 5 0 R\n/Size 11\n>>\nstartxref\n"
out += str(xref_offset).encode() + b"\n%%EOF\n"

with open(OUT, "wb") as f:
    f.write(bytes(out))
print(f"Wrote {OUT} ({len(out)} bytes)")

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Validate the merged PDF
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
merged = bytes(out)
parsed = extract_objects(merged)
checks = {}

checks["all objects present"] = set(range(1, 11)) <= set(parsed)
checks["xref offsets correct"] = all(
    merged[offsets[n]:].startswith(f"{n} 0 obj".encode()) for n in range(1, 11)
)
checks["pages tree (Count 2, cover first)"] = (
    b"/Count 2" in parsed[7] and b"/Kids [ 9 0 R 4 0 R ]" in parsed[7]
)
checks["cover page -> contents 10 / parent 7"] = (
    b"/Contents 10 0 R" in parsed[9] and b"/Parent 7 0 R" in parsed[9]
)
checks["cover stream length matches"] = (
    b"/Length " + str(len(content)).encode() in parsed[10]
)
checks["title in cover stream"] = TITLE.encode() in content
checks["date in cover stream"] = DATE_STR.encode() in content

# Verify the original (copied) content stream still decodes: ASCII85 + Flate.
m8 = re.search(rb"stream\r?\n(.*?)endstream", parsed[8], re.S)
raw85 = m8.group(1)
if raw85.endswith(b"~>"):
    raw85 = raw85[:-2]
try:
    report_text = zlib.decompress(base64.a85decode(raw85, adobe=False))
    checks["original report stream decodes"] = len(report_text) > 0
    report_snippet = report_text[:200].decode("latin-1", "replace").replace("\n", " | ")
except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
    checks["original report stream decodes"] = False
    report_snippet = f"decode error: {e}"

all_ok = True
for name, ok in checks.items():
    print(f"  validation - {name}: {'OK' if ok else 'FAILED'}")
    all_ok = all_ok and ok

print(f"Cover date used: {DATE_STR}")
print(f"Original report content snippet: {report_snippet}")

if not all_ok:
    raise SystemExit("Validation failed")
print("Validation passed.")
